units.source_text: [\[24\]](#part1330.html#w24) 此先帝与皇上的关系不明。

en.t: The relationship between this former emperor and the reigning emperor is unclear.

units.source_text: 或说是皇上的堂兄弟或伯叔父，则此四公主是皇上的侄女或堂姐妹。

en.t: Some say he was either the emperor's cousin or his uncle, in which case this Fourth Princess would have been the emperor's niece or cousin.
